motion.purpose: Masthead and lead headline hover, reduced-motion aware.

components.name: Newsroom navigation
components.description: Topic navigation with visible active and focus states.
components.html: The latestArtificial intelligenceCrypto
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:30px;border-top:3px solid var(--ink);border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink);padding:16px 0;font:700 13px Arial,sans-serif}.ds-nav a{color:var(--ink);text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a[aria-current]{color:var(--red);text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:7px}.ds-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--red);outline-offset:5px}
